# region_activation

地图里写左边的值，不写右边的英文说明。Write the left-hand value in the map, not the English description on the right.

| 值 Value | 说明 Description |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No activation |
| 1 | ''USE'' key (with button) |
| 2 | Character not in vehicle |
| 3 | Character in a vehicle |
| 4 | Character |
| 5 | By movable |
| 6 | Player |
| 7 | Containing all Singleplayer heroes |
| 8 | ''USE'' key (without button) |
| 9 | ''USE'' key, only Red team (with button) |
| 10 | ''USE'' key, only Blue team (with button) |
| 11 | ''USE'' key, only Red team (without button) |
| 12 | ''USE'' key, only Blue team (without button) |
| 13 | Red team Player |
| 14 | Blue team Player |
| 15 | ''USE'' key (without button, without sound) |
| 16 | ''USE'' key (without sound) |
| 17 | Actor |
| 18 | Enemy Actor |
